notes.subject: with
notes.rationale: verb פחדו takes a direct object in Hebrew; English needs 'with terror' to carry the cognate accusative

notes.subject: פחדו/פחד
notes.rationale: verb and noun from the same root — 'they trembled a trembling' — the cognate doubling is lost in English

notes.subject: בדור צדיק
notes.rationale: 'God is in the generation of the righteous' (among the upright) vs 'God is the refuge/protection of the righteous generation'

notes.subject: there
notes.rationale: שם points without a named location, a deliberately vague deictic

translation: There they trembled ⟨with⟩ terror, for Elohim is in the generation of the just.
